title: Cái này có thịt trong đó.
pronunciation: Cai nay co thit trong do
summary: For pointing out meat in a dish when a vegetarian, allergy, or dietary limit changes the order.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use this after spotting meat in the dish, tray, sauce, or filling.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Point to the exact piece or menu photo while you say it. The issue is the meat, not the whole meal.

phrases.vietnamese: Cái này có thịt trong đó.
phrases.pronunciation: Cai nay co thit trong do

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Hear Cái này + có thịt trong as the reference point, then compare it with the full phrase.

breakdown.vietnamese: Cái này có thịt trong đó.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Best before eating or paying, while staff can still explain, remake, or suggest another dish.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể làm món này không có nguyên liệu này được không?
phrases.english: Can you make it without this ingredient?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the lam mon nay khong co nguyen lieu nay duoc khong

phrases.vietnamese: Món ăn nào an toàn nhất cho người bị dị ứng này?
phrases.english: Which dish is safest for this allergy?
phrases.pronunciation: Mon an nao an toan nhat cho nguoi bi di ung nay

phrases.vietnamese: Đây là thịt lợn, thịt bò hay thịt gà?
phrases.english: Is this pork, beef, or chicken?
phrases.pronunciation: Day la thit lon thit bo hay thit ga

phrases.vietnamese: Cái này có chứa tôm không?
phrases.pronunciation: Cai nay co chua tom khong

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Meat can hide in broth, filling, or garnish. Ask again if the answer only covers the visible pieces.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Move next to no-meat, without-this-ingredient, fish-sauce allergy, or shellfish allergy cards if safety matters.

phrases.vietnamese: Cái này có nước mắm không?
phrases.pronunciation: Cai nay co nuoc mam khong

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi có thể gọi món này mà không có thịt được không?
phrases.english: Can I order this without meat?
phrases.pronunciation: Toi co the goi mon nay ma khong co thit duoc khong

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: No-meat and without-this-ingredient cards are stronger before ordering; this line is for what is already in front of you.
